characters.name: Seila
characters.voice_notes: Gladias's wife, blogger on economics and culture, mother of Zven and Lily. Sharp, quick, warm but direct; in ch21 and ch23 she is furious and shouts (lines in capitals), in ch20 a determined investigator who wins people's trust.

characters.name: Mov
characters.voice_notes: Keeper and Gladias's shadowy, security-savvy friend who does surveillance; large imposing physique. Dry, low-key, serious; apologetic and careful in ch20.

characters.name: Telroy
characters.voice_notes: A Keeper (cybersecurity rubric group) surprised at his door; cautious but polite and open, measured speaker.

characters.name: Balme
characters.voice_notes: A Keeper (private-schools rubric group); soft-spoken, slightly wary at first, then curious and earnest.

characters.name: Lectoby
characters.voice_notes: A Keeper (social media openness rubric group); weary, upset and subdued because his wife is stuck in Northglade, but kind and hospitable.

characters.name: Febric
characters.voice_notes: Son of co-family Vil and Daia; computer-science kid, calm and matter-of-fact, more laconic than Hreda.

characters.name: Hreda
characters.age: teen (school age, exact age not given)
characters.voice_notes: Daughter of co-family Vil and Daia; a math prodigy, bright, proud and precise; frightened but brave in her written messages from Northglade.

notes: No exceptions. F and H occur only inside the message block 20:12 (written text messages from Febric and Hreda, read on Seila's device; one F run, four H runs).
